today_summary: GCM26 opens the week at $4,436.60, +$16.80 (+0.38%) on Friday, with ATM IV collapsing 1.33pp to 21.89% — the lowest reading of the five-day window — and the 1σ daily band tightening to $61.18 (1.38%). Total volume of 4,717 contracts is the thinnest session of the window, down 31% from Friday's 6,839, so today's tape is a liquidity vacuum rather than a directional statement. The tradable max pain — computed on the ±25% strike window, excluding the 88,465 far-OTM calls stacked at $6,000 and above that produce the untradable $6,200 headline — sits at $4,695, $258 above spot, a mild upward pull. That pull is gated: 14,461 contracts of call OI at $4,500/$4,510 supply +187 of the +279 net GEX inside ±$200 of spot, and stand directly between price and the max-pain basin.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions produced almost no structural change: spot netted +$17.60 (+0.40%) from $4,419 to $4,436.60, the gamma flip printed $4,510 in all five sessions, the $3,500 put wall held all five, and windowed max pain drifted just $30 ($4,665 → $4,695). Net GEX within ±$200 of spot never left the +274 to +284 band, so dealers have been continuously long gamma and the long-gamma pocket that has capped every rally attempt is exactly as deep today as it was on 08-11. The one genuine regime change is in volatility, and it arrived today: ATM IV had built to 23.39% by 08-13, then gave back 1.50pp to 21.89%, dragging the 1σ band from $65.81 to $61.18 while volume decayed from a 7,659-contract peak on 08-13 to 4,717 today. Positioning migrated up, not down — $5,500 call OI added 676 contracts (12,774 → 13,450), $4,600 added 530 (4,649 → 5,179), while the $4,500 block bled 294 — which is why max pain sits above spot rather than below it. The lone counterweight is a persistent downside hedge bid at $4,000, where put OI grew 235 contracts across the window and absorbed today's single largest print of 306 contracts.
what_changed: ATM IV broke down 1.33pp to 21.89%, the window's low, cutting the 1σ daily band from $65.81 at the 08-13 peak to $61.18.
Total volume fell to 4,717 contracts, down 31% from Friday and the thinnest session of the five — conviction is absent, not bearish.
$4,600 call OI built 4,649 → 5,179 (+530) and $5,500 built 12,774 → 13,450 (+676), pulling windowed max pain to $4,695, above spot.
$4,500 call OI decayed 9,728 → 9,434 (-294), the only meaningful erosion in the near-spot ceiling.
$4,000 put OI grew 3,116 → 3,351 (+235) and took today's largest single print at 306 contracts — the standing downside hedge.
Gamma flip $4,510, put wall $3,500, and net GEX (+274 to +284) were unchanged in all five sessions — the structure has not moved.
prediction: Bias neutral-to-mildly-bullish: windowed max pain at $4,695 pulls $258 higher, but the $4,500/$4,510 call block holds +187 of net GEX and will absorb the first approach. Expect the $61.18 1σ band to contain the session with rallies stalling into $4,500 and dips bought above $4,375 — compressed IV plus record-thin volume argues for a coiling range, not a trend day. A sustained trade above $4,510 unlocks $4,600 (5,179 call OI) and validates the upside pull; below $4,375 the positive gamma nodes at $4,400 and $4,350 are lost and price opens to the $4,300 put shelf (2,323 contracts).
